'''Lafek Iss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] affiliated with the [[House Salaktori]] guild who operated during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Iss was an electronics and [[Computer/Legends|computer]] expert, who also had experience in the fields of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] programming and anti-surveillance measures. He worked alone and had a reputation for secrecy. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Iss was available for contract in [[Feris City]].<ref name="BM" />
